```python
import holidays
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from obter_dados_b3 import main as obter_dados_b3
import pandas as pd
from dateutil.relativedelta import relativedelta
import numpy as np
from io import StringIO
import sqlalchemy as db

##Taxa de risco de operações de energia Aneel
TaxaAneel = 0.04512

##Porcentagem da taxa aneel applicada de acordo com o Rating
TaxaRating = {
    "A": 0, 
    "B": 0.25, 
    "C": 0.5, 
    'D': 0.75, 
    "E": 1
}

##OBTER FERIADOS
feriado = holidays.BrasilBolsaBalcao(years = datetime.now().year)
datas = [data.strftime("%Y-%m-%d") for data in feriado.keys()]

##OBTER DADOS DE CDI X PRE DA B3
b3 = obter_dados_b3()
b3 = pd.read_json(StringIO(b3))

b3 = b3[['day360', 'rate']]
b3['rate'] = b3['rate'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '.').astype(float) / 100
print(b3)
hoje = datetime.now()

ini_mes = hoje.replace(day = 1, hour = 0, minute = 0, second = 0, microsecond = 0)

prox_mes = (ini_mes + relativedelta(months = 1))

meses = []

for n in range(0, 121):
    meses.append([prox_mes + relativedelta(months = n), (n+1)*21])

#DF com datas e taxas
dfTaxa = pd.DataFrame(meses, columns = ["Month_Ini", "DU21"])
dfTaxa['Month_End'] = dfTaxa["Month_Ini"] + pd.offsets.MonthEnd(1)
dfTaxa['Month_End'] = pd.to_datetime((dfTaxa['Month_End']))
dfTaxa['Month_Ini'] = pd.to_datetime((dfTaxa['Month_Ini']))

#Delta de dias uteis
dfTaxa['DU'] = np.busday_count(np.array(hoje, dtype='datetime64[D]'),  np.array(dfTaxa['Month_End'], dtype='datetime64[D]'), holidays = np.array(datas, dtype='datetime64[D]'))

#DU encontrado na lista da b3 anterior ao DU calculado para o mes
dfTaxa["DU-"] = dfTaxa.apply(lambda x: b3[b3['day360'] <= x['DU']]['day360'].max(), axis =1)

#DU encontrado na lista da b3 posterior ao DU calculado para o mes
dfTaxa["DU+"] = dfTaxa.apply(lambda x: b3[b3['day360'] >= x['DU']]['day360'].min(), axis =1)

# Taxas do DU+ e DU-
dfTaxa = pd.merge(dfTaxa, b3, how='left', left_on='DU+', right_on='day360') \
           .drop(columns='day360') \
           .rename(columns={"rate": 'Taxa+'})

dfTaxa = pd.merge(dfTaxa, b3, how='left', left_on='DU-', right_on='day360') \
           .drop(columns='day360') \
           .rename(columns={"rate": 'Taxa-'})

# Index Médio CDI do horizonte de DU
dfTaxa['i1'] =  (1+dfTaxa['Taxa-']).pow(dfTaxa['DU-']/252)
dfTaxa['i2'] =  (1+dfTaxa['Taxa+']).pow(dfTaxa['DU+']/252)
dfTaxa['P1'] = dfTaxa['DU'] - dfTaxa['DU-']
dfTaxa['P2'] = dfTaxa['DU+'] - dfTaxa['DU-']
dfTaxa['TaxaCDIAvg'] = dfTaxa['i1']*(dfTaxa['i2']/dfTaxa['i1']).pow(dfTaxa['P1']/dfTaxa['P2'])
dfTaxa['TaxaCDIAvg'] =  dfTaxa['TaxaCDIAvg'].pow(252/dfTaxa['DU']) - 1

# Taxa DI + desconto por rating
for r in ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E']:\
    dfTaxa['TaxaAcc_r' + r] = ((1+dfTaxa['TaxaCDIAvg'])*(1+TaxaAneel*TaxaRating[r])).pow(dfTaxa['DU21']/252)-1

#Mes corrente com taxa 0
New_row = {'Month_Ini' : [ini_mes], 'Month_End': [prox_mes + timedelta(days=-1)], "TaxaCDIAvg" : [0], 'TaxaAcc_rA': [0], 'TaxaAcc_rB': [0], 'TaxaAcc_rC': [0], 'TaxaAcc_rD': [0], 'TaxaAcc_rE': [0]}
dfTaxa = pd.concat([dfTaxa,pd.DataFrame().from_dict(New_row)], ignore_index = True)
dfTaxa['Month_End'] = pd.to_datetime((dfTaxa['Month_End']))
dfTaxa['Month_Ini'] = pd.to_datetime((dfTaxa['Month_Ini']))

#Reformata df e envia para banco
dfTaxa= dfTaxa[['Month_Ini', 'Month_End','TaxaCDIAvg', 'TaxaAcc_rA', 'TaxaAcc_rB', 'TaxaAcc_rC', 'TaxaAcc_rD', 'TaxaAcc_rE']]
dfTaxa.set_index(['Month_Ini', 'Month_End'], inplace= True)
dfTaxa= dfTaxa.stack().reset_index().rename(columns = {'level_2': "Index_Type", 0: 'Index_Value'})
dfTaxa['Data_Ref'] = hoje.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

##Conexão com o banco
server = 'SPVDSQL01'
database = 'DBENERGYDATA'
engine = db.create_engine(f"mssql://{server}/{database}?trusted_connection=yes&driver=ODBC+Driver+17+for+SQL+Server", fast_executemany = True)
conn = engine.connect()

comando = "DELETE FROM rsk.INDEX_CDI_RATING WHERE Data_Ref = \'" + str(hoje.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')) + "\'"
sql_query = db.text(comando)
result = conn.execute(sql_query)
conn.commit()

dfTaxa.to_sql("INDEX_CDI_RATING", engine,schema = 'rsk', if_exists = 'append', index=False)
```
